title: Refuse duplicate hand retries; add --force and status line
summary: Hand commands that queue a retry, re-ask or follow-up for a failed job (`athena retry` first) refuse when a linked retry is queued or running, or the failure review is pending. The refusal queues nothing and names the retry id or says the review is pending. `--force` allows a second retry and records an intervention; `athena status` shows the state. Audience: the person running Athena by hand.

defaults_applied.how: Tests cover the four acceptance cases; fmt, clippy and test must pass.
Criteria run the retry path and check refusal, queue and record effects.
The guard is enforced in code on the shared retry path, with tests.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs (Athena::retry at line 1274: resolves the job, checks line pause, reaps the registry, refuses an interrupted job already retried via retries_by_job, then calls ask), crates/athena-cli/src/commands.rs (retry at line 25 calls athena.retry), crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs (Command::Retry { job, yes, json } at line 1057), crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (a field at line 100 already shows the retry id for an interrupted job), crates/athena-data/src/records/core.rs (the Intervention record kind at line 197). The existing guard covers only an interrupted (Dispatched) job. This change widens it to every failed state and adds the pending-review check. Retry, re-ask and follow-up entry points beyond `retry` are located by the producer via Grep for callers of Athena::ask with the 'try again on' prefix. Any new record or data file under crates/ is covered by check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test; a new intervention kind goes through the athena-data allow-list.

Field meaning: no existing field is reused; `--force` is a new CLI flag on Retry and any other hand re-ask command. The intervention record reuses the existing Intervention kind in crates/athena-data/src/records/core.rs.

The failure review is Athena's introspection of a failed job. It is pending when the job failed and its introspection record is not yet written. The producer finds the existing introspection and has_retry_introspection logic in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs and reuses it. Automatic retry paths (drain, steward) are untouched.

The refusal is newly applied to hand retries of failed jobs. Expected 5% of newly refused readings, and the higher refusal rate is intended: it stops a duplicate retry that is then closed as a duplicate.
Governance files: none change. athena.toml, defaults.toml and workflows are unaffected. CHANGELOG.md gets the default entry.

Previous result: this is not a retry of an earlier job; the file named in the request, records/introspections/2026-11/20261101-102346-0dyj.json, is the introspection that motivated it. It is read-only evidence and never changes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs or crates/athena-core/src/reading tests, with a retry for a failed job already queued, shows the hand retry refused, the error naming the existing retry id, and the job and record set unchanged. `cargo test` runs it.
A test where the failure review of the failed job is pending shows the hand retry refused with a message saying the review is pending, and nothing queued. `cargo test` runs it.

A test with no linked retry and no pending review shows the hand retry queuing a proposal exactly as before. `cargo test` runs it, and the existing tests in crates/athena-cli/tests/retry.rs still pass.
A test where `--force` is given with a retry already queued shows a second retry queued and an intervention record written. `cargo test` runs it.
A test of `athena status` for a failed job shows 'failure review pending' when the review is pending and the queued retry id when one is queued (crates/athena-core/src/status.rs tests).

The diff adds the `--force` flag to Command::Retry in crates/athena-cli/src/main.rs and to every other hand command that queues a retry, re-ask or follow-up. The guard sits in the shared path in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs, not copied per command.
The diff touches no automatic retry path (drain, steward), and CHANGELOG.md records the change.
`cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass (or a recorded Athena check on the final tree passed).

out_of_scope: Automatic retry behaviour (drain, steward) does not change.
Edits to anything under records/, including the named introspection file.
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass rate than the reference: it touches the CLI, core and status, and needs a new intervention write path.
urgent_reason: It cuts wasted work from duplicate retries that are closed as duplicates.
hard_reason: It adds a refusal rule that can hold work (a guard on retry) and changes the retry pipeline path and intervention records.
